node.statement: Polar binder identification: under the transported lem-stage1-polar-retraction guard, Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H is a C^1 diffeomorphism from calU times B_delta^{calH}(J) onto the same image S_delta used in node 1. Hence its inverse exists uniquely, and the u_delta explicitly bound in node 1 is exactly the first inverse component supplied by lem-stage1-polar-retraction and consequently the polar inverse component used by the imported group and inversion statements.
